title: SYNTHETIC minimal case — two pages, four display equations
disclaimer: Hand-authored word-level TSV; not extracted from a real PDF. Used only to demonstrate the pipeline end to end.

source.note: In a real run this comes from `pdftotext -tsv` or pymupdf word extraction of the case PDF discovered under /input.

output_contract.equations: list of detected equations: eq_number, page, bbox, linearized text with ^/_ markup, verification status
output_contract.symbol_audit: reconciliation of mapped symbol counts (raw vs linearized) and the list of unmappable unknown characters
output_contract.uncertainty: explicit list of unknown symbols, numbering anomalies and any line that could not be verified
